title: PR map blocked — which path?
intent: A PR overlay needs one named path to compare before and after. The request named a PR but no flow. Ask; do not guess from the PR description.

questions.ask: Which path should this PR be drawn on — create-order, or another flow by name?
questions.because: A PR overlay is before/after of one path; the diff touches files in more than one feature.

questions.ask: Compare against main, or against the release branch?
questions.because: The base ref decides what counts as before.
